args.title: Make error toasts assertive and persistent
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider and toast handling in src/components/Toast.tsx so that error toasts use role="alert" with aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds, ensuring screen reader users are notified immediately and errors remain visible until explicitly dismissed.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should use an assertive live region and remain visible until dismissed rather than timing out like standard info toasts.
